svg.title: Tasnim Hassan, analytics and AI
svg.desc: Analytics and AI, grounded in four years of corporate finance. MMA candidate at McGill Desautels, GPA 4.0. Previously Informa, Assembly Global and KPMG in London. The panel shows 1,600 real orders from the Olist test set sorted by predicted late-delivery risk: reviewing the riskiest 10% catches 23 of the 65 late orders in this sample.
